ru.name: Абсолют: Взять за горло

Эффекты увеличения и уменьшения скорости атаки, навыков не действуют.

en.name: Absolute: Chokeslam
en.description: Rapidly approach the opponent and grab them by the neck.
en.command: {KeyBind:GrabOrGuard} {KeyBind:Kick} or {KeyBind:Attack2} during skill to headbutt Can be added to a Quick Slot
tooltip: 77.3% damage in PvP only
